## Field Work Schedule and Protocols

-   Field work is scheduled for Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, leaving Mondays and Fridays for non-field data tasks unless weather requires schedule shifts.
-   The team completed field sampling at school sites in Lakeville, encountering extremely dense, highly compacted soils and high percentages of coarse fragments.
-   Compaction at the Lakeville elementary school site was attributed to human activity and human-transported material (HTM) near building foundations, rather than natural till.
-   One Lakeville site was flagged for a potential field review day due to digging difficulty.
-   The team collected bulk density samples at the Lakeville sites despite high resistance and coarse fragments.
-   Foot traffic during excavation can compact the top 10 centimeters of soil; deeper soil layers remain largely unaffected by walking.
-   Field protocol update: The team will use flags to mark two sides of a pit face to prevent soil compaction where top-horizon bulk density samples will be taken.
-   The team needs to acquire bread knives for cutting volumetric cubes in organic or surface horizons.
